findings.title: Freeze executable literal independent cases before Ready
findings.problem: All36 entries are prose trigger/expected labels. There is no concrete typed seed, literal diagnostics projection/quality expected object, known canonical byte/hash oracle or explicit chunk boundary vector. For example E108-09 cannot independently determine the exact six-count/aggregate projection, and E108-31 cannot check canonical escaping/assembly against production-independent bytes. Future tests can reproduce implementation choices while satisfying these descriptions.
findings.requested_change: Retain these coverage descriptions, but add pre-implementation literal seeds and independently authored expected JSON/bytes/hash/length for at least a complete diagnostic projection including association/large numeric/null/unknown semantics, all-five-status/all14-reason quality counts, a supported explanation/receipt parity fixture and multi-chunk ASCII artifact with exact offsets/next/complete. Freeze concrete mutation/refusal vectors and inclusive/one-above construction recipes for the stated budgets; do not claim newly produced/runtime evidence.

findings.title: Define the manifest and exact admission accounting
findings.problem: The inclusive64KiB manifest and4MiB aggregate are public admission limits, and the contract includes cached quality summary and manifest bytes, but no manifest field layout/canonical representation, ordering or accounting formula is specified anywhere in the eight files. Its documented focus/diagnostic identity is referenced at line36. Implementations can therefore charge different data or different byte sequences and disagree on E108-16. Owner error codes are listed but only the dependency error has an exact exception contract.
findings.requested_change: Freeze an exact internal/public manifest layout (or explicitly remove it as a separate representation and define an equally precise accounting alternative), canonicalization/order and bytes counted per entry/shared profile/quality/reports; define container/key/value node accounting. State exact owner exception type/code mapping, including accepted-library limit errors versus semantic errors and constructor precedence. Add hand-computable at/one-above fixtures using that formula. This concerns deterministic logical admission, not total RSS or physical guarantees.
